Markets.title: Stocks in news: Banks, HCL Technologies, DMart, Adani Green Energy, PTC Industries and Anand Rathi Wealth
Markets.summary: Indian equity markets recovered significantly as the Nifty 50 and Sensex closed higher due to bargain buying and positive global cues. Banking stocks and companies like HCL Technologies, DMart, Adani Green Energy, and PTC Industries are expected to draw investor attention.

Markets.title: IPO Rush: Eight issues to raise over Rs 11,000 crore this week
Markets.summary: Eight initial public offerings, consisting of six mainboard and two SME issues, are launching this week to raise over Rs 11,000 crore. Zetwork Manufacturing leads the group with a targeted Rs 5,000 crore, followed by Bonfiglioli Transmission and Tonbo Imaging India.

Markets.title: Nifty's recovery or just another trap? Analysts split on market's future direction!
Markets.summary: Analysts are divided on the Nifty's recent recovery and advise a cautious approach until it achieves a sustained close above key resistance levels. They recommend monitoring support levels while selectively accumulating resilient stocks like Aurobindo Pharma and TCS during market dips.

Markets.title: DBS Chief sees overseas confidence in India despite capital outflow concerns
Markets.summary: DBS Bank CEO Tan Su Shan expressed strong international confidence in India's economic growth, driven by high demand for FCNR(B) deposits and potential in artificial intelligence. Despite foreign net sales impacting the rupee, she remains optimistic about the country's foreign direct investment and digital infrastructure.

Markets.title: RBI to meet daily dollar needs of 3 state-run oil firms to ease rupee pressure
Markets.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is meeting the daily $200 million dollar import needs of three state-run oil companies. This intervention aims to reduce pressure on the rupee caused by high demand for foreign currency.

Markets.title: Pressure on rupee may continue after temporary gains on RBI actions, say economists
Markets.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has taken emergency steps like transaction limits and cash reserve requirements to stabilize the declining rupee. However, economists warn that rising US bond yields and foreign investment outflows will likely cause the rupee to keep falling.

Geo-Political.title: Trump's 'energy ceasefire' claim welcomed by Zelensky but Russia silent
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky supports Donald Trump's proposal for an energy ceasefire with Russia. Moscow has not yet responded to the announcement.

Geo-Political.title: One killed, 11 injured in second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport in two days
Geo-Political.summary: A Houthi missile strike on the Riyadh airport killed one person and injured 11 others over the weekend. This attack marks the second time in two days that the Iran-backed Yemeni group has targeted the Saudi capital.

Geo-Political.title: Poland detains man suspected of planning assassination of PM Tusk
Geo-Political.summary: Polish police detained a man suspected of plotting an assassination against Prime Minister Donald Tusk. Authorities acted on credible intelligence indicating potential attacks targeting both Tusk and his defense minister.

Geo-Political.title: Dozens of gold prospectors killed in strikes on Egypt-Sudan border, rights group says
Geo-Political.summary: Dozens of gold prospectors were reportedly killed in airstrikes on an artisanal mining camp along the Egypt-Sudan border. Neither the Egyptian nor the Sudanese government has issued a comment regarding the incident.

Geo-Political.title: Homes and bridges swept away as fresh floods hit Nepal
Geo-Political.summary: Fresh floods in Nepal have swept away homes and bridges. This disaster comes less than two months after catastrophic floods left thousands dead and missing, while the country was still trying to recover.

Geo-Political.title: Ukraine strikes Yandex data centre in third attack on Russian tech giant
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine has attacked the Russian tech company Yandex for the third time this week by striking one of its data centers. The attacks have forced Yandex to suspend its operations.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights the growing shift toward AI optimization over traditional search engine optimization for organic traffic.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators streamline their workflows and maintain a competitive edge.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools of 2023 that drive industry innovation and efficiency. These advanced applications automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase overall productivity.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: AI content generators help users efficiently create engaging and relevant material for their target audiences. With many tools currently available on the market, choosing the right AI writer can be challenging.

Data & Insights.title: The week ahead in numbers: Inflation pressures, IMF’s growth forecasts, crude output
Data & Insights.summary: Upcoming economic developments include data releases on inflation pressures and crude output. The week will also feature the International Monetary Fund's latest growth forecasts.

Data & Insights.title: Economic think tank says govt should withdraw proposed UPI charges. Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: An economic think tank has urged the government to withdraw a proposed 0.4% fee on UPI merchant transactions exceeding ₹2,000. The group warned that the fee would increase prices, harm small businesses, and reduce consumer demand.

Data & Insights.title: RBI may hike repo rate by 75-100 bps in current cycle as inflation persists- SBI Capital flags December hike risk
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Capital predicts the RBI will raise the repo rate by 75 to 100 basis points in the current cycle due to persistent inflation. A larger-than-usual rate hike remains possible in December 2026, though gradual increases are still the most likely scenario.

Data & Insights.title: Reserve Bank of India takes steps to support rupee, opens dollar window for oil companies
Data & Insights.summary: To support the struggling rupee, the Reserve Bank of India is directly supplying dollars to three state-run oil companies. Additionally, the central bank has tightened regulations on currency derivatives to reduce market volatility and foreign-exchange demand.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: rate hikes, SIP flows, Airtel’s tariffs
Data & Insights.summary: Mint's weekly Plain Facts compilation uses data-driven charts to analyze major news stories from the past week. The latest edition covers key topics including interest rate hikes, mutual fund SIP flows, and Airtel's tariff changes.

Data & Insights.title: CEA bats for a review of loan overdue rules for MSMEs
Data & Insights.summary: Chief Economic Adviser V. Anantha Nageswaran has recommended adjusting MSME loan overdue rules to match their actual cash-flow cycles. He stated that policies should avoid rigid, uniform global standards in favor of approaches better suited to these businesses.

India.title: Over 2,500 Bottles Of Liquor, Smuggled Under Old Clothes, Seized In Gujarat
India.summary: Gujarat police arrested three men—Nishit Shah, Jay Pawar, and Kishan Shah—for smuggling over 2,500 bottles of liquor hidden under old clothes. Officers seized the thousands of alcohol bottles, which were stored in a flat and its hallway ready for dispatch.

India.title: Power Bank Triggers Fire On Delhi-Chennai IndiGo Flight, Plane Diverted To Hyderabad
India.summary: A power bank caught fire on a Delhi-Chennai IndiGo flight, prompting passengers to use their bags to help extinguish the flames. The aircraft was successfully diverted to Hyderabad as a result of the incident.

India.title: 'Sachin Pilot Can Deny Ticket, My Leader Is Rahul Gandhi': Raja Warring Defiant At Punjab Congress Unity Show
India.summary: During a Punjab Congress leadership transition, Amarinder Singh Raja Warring declared his absolute loyalty to Rahul Gandhi and the party. Warring stated this unwavering commitment even if national leader Sachin Pilot decides to deny him a future election ticket.

India.title: Delhi CJP Protest News Highlights: Delhi Police Issues Traffic Advisory For Monday With Several Diversions
India.summary: Delhi police detained about 3,000 people across the city on Saturday during protests. Authorities have issued a traffic advisory with several diversions for Monday.

India.title: For First Time, BJP Releases Manifesto For Rajasthan Panchayat Elections
India.summary: The BJP has released its manifesto for the Rajasthan Panchayat elections for the first time. The party's state and national leadership are actively participating in the campaign with the same effort as major assembly and Lok Sabha polls.

India.title: Bhagat Singh Photo On Ludhiana Voter Roll Sparks Row, Authorities Clarify
India.summary: A Congress leader flagged an issue after a photograph resembling freedom fighter Bhagat Singh was mistakenly placed on a voter roll in Ludhiana East. Local authorities have since clarified the incident.

General.title: Trump's 'energy ceasefire' claim welcomed by Zelensky but Russia silent
General.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has welcomed Donald Trump's proposal for an energy ceasefire. Meanwhile, the Russian government has not yet responded to the idea.

General.title: One killed, 11 injured in second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport in two days
General.summary: One person was killed and 11 others were injured during a Houthi missile attack on the Riyadh airport over the weekend. This marks the second strike by the Iran-backed Yemeni group on the Saudi capital's airport in two days.

General.title: PM says it is 'clear' Russia interfered with Brexit vote
General.summary: The British Prime Minister stated that Russia clearly interfered in the Brexit referendum. He added that voters were not adequately informed about foreign efforts to disrupt UK democracy.

General.title: Wildlife park remains closed after fatal tiger attack
General.summary: Yorkshire Wildlife Park remains closed following a fatal tiger attack on Saturday. The incident occurred after a man entered the tiger enclosure.

General.title: Poland detains man suspected of planning assassination of PM Tusk
General.summary: Polish police arrested a man suspected of plotting to assassinate Prime Minister Donald Tusk. Authorities acted after receiving credible intelligence regarding planned attacks against Tusk and his defense minister.

General.title: DUP MP says her party could help remove O'Neill as first minister over Drumcree row
General.summary: DUP MP Carla Lockhart stated her party could help remove Michelle O'Neill as First Minister due to unionist anger over O'Neill's past role in Garvaghy Road protests. Lockhart made the remarks amid controversy surrounding the Drumcree parade dispute.
